faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1_body: Gold is a hedge against inflation, currency devaluation, and economic uncertainty. It has maintained value across centuries and provides portfolio diversification.
faq.q2_body: Interest rates, inflation, geopolitical tensions, currency strength, and central bank policies all influence gold prices significantly.
faq.q3_body: Buy from reputable dealers, verify purity and weight, consider storage options (vault, home safe), and maintain proper insurance coverage.
faq.q4_body: Gold investments may be subject to capital gains tax. Consult with tax professionals to optimize your strategy based on local regulations.
faq.disclaimer_body: Gold investments carry risks including market volatility, liquidity constraints, storage costs, and currency fluctuations. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Please consult with a qualified financial advisor before making investment decisions. This information is for educational purposes only and not financial advice.
